ws.new.note: Spaces menu: the command that opens the editor for a new space.

ws.list.emptyHint.message: Save a set of tabs and switch back to it any time.
ws.list.emptyHint.note: Spaces menu, shown when there are no spaces yet.

ws.row.edit.note: Accessible name of the ••• button on a space row; {name} is the space's own name.

ws.undo.deleted.note: Spaces menu row after a space is deleted; {name} is the space's own name. An Undo button follows.

ws.undo.button.note: Button that brings back the space just deleted.

ws.editor.newTitle.note: Spaces menu: heading of the editor for a new space.

ws.editor.editTitle.note: Spaces menu: heading of the editor for an existing space.

ws.editor.name.note: Space editor: accessible name and placeholder of the space name field.

ws.editor.color.note: Space editor: label above the color swatches.

ws.editor.symbol.note: Space editor: label above the grid of symbols.

ws.editor.startWith.note: New space editor: label of the choice between this window's tabs and an empty space.

ws.editor.thisWindow.message: {count, plural, one {This window · # tab} other {This window · # tabs}}
ws.editor.thisWindow.note: New space editor: segment that saves this window's ordinary tabs into the new space.

ws.editor.empty.note: New space editor: segment that starts the new space with no tabs.

ws.editor.done.note: Space editor: primary button; changes are already saved.

ws.error.invalidColor.message: That isn’t a color Blanc can use. Pick a swatch, or enter a hex color like #426C4C.
ws.error.invalidColor.note: Space editor error for an unusable color value.

ws.error.invalidSymbol.message: That symbol isn’t available. Pick one from the list.
ws.error.invalidSymbol.note: Space editor error for an unknown symbol.

ws.decision.title.note: Heading of the prompt shown before switching would close tabs; {name} is the space's own name.

ws.decision.saveThenSwitch.message: Save them as a space, then switch
ws.decision.saveThenSwitch.note: Switch prompt: primary button that saves this window's tabs as a new space before switching.

spaces.mark.current.note: Accessible name of the space mark at the start of the Island; {name} is the space's own name.

spaces.color.sage.note: Name of a preset space color (a soft green), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.sky.note: Name of a preset space color (a soft blue), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.iris.note: Name of a preset space color (a soft violet), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.rose.note: Name of a preset space color (a soft pink), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.clay.note: Name of a preset space color (a soft orange-brown), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.sand.note: Name of a preset space color (a soft gold), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.slate.note: Name of a preset space color (a blue-grey), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.graphite.note: Name of a preset space color (a dark grey), read by screen readers.

spaces.color.custom.note: Space editor: swatch that opens the custom color picker.

spaces.symbol.briefcase.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.house.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.code.note: Name of a space symbol (angle brackets), read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.flask.note: Name of a space symbol (a lab flask), read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.book.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.music.note: Name of a space symbol (a music note), read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.camera.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.plane.note: Name of a space symbol (an airplane), read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.heart.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.star.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.leaf.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.coffee.note: Name of a space symbol (a coffee cup), read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.cap.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.gamepad.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.wallet.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.symbol.sun.note: Name of a space symbol, read by screen readers.

spaces.picker.square.note: Accessible name of the custom color picker's square; arrow keys change it.

spaces.picker.squareValue.note: Spoken value of the custom color picker's square; both are whole numbers from 0 to 100.

spaces.picker.hue.note: Accessible name of the custom color picker's hue slider.

spaces.picker.hex.note: Label of the custom color picker's hex code field, as in #426C4C.

spaces.guard.light.message: Kept readable: shown as {hex} in light mode.
spaces.guard.light.note: Custom color picker: Blanc draws a slightly darker color so the symbol stays readable; {hex} is a code like #6D6400.

spaces.guard.dark.message: Kept readable: shown as {hex} in dark mode.
spaces.guard.dark.note: Custom color picker: Blanc draws a slightly lighter color so the symbol stays readable; {hex} is a code like #6D6400.

spaces.guard.both.message: Kept readable: shown as {light} in light mode and {dark} in dark mode.
spaces.guard.both.note: Custom color picker: Blanc adjusts the drawn color in both modes; {light} and {dark} are codes like #6D6400.

result.tag.space.note: Lowercase tag on a Quick Switcher result that is a space.

workspaceMenu.edit.note: Right-click menu on a space row: opens the space editor.

newtab.checklist.space.note: Start page moving-in checklist task: opens the Spaces menu.
